note: Ironclad Hearthguard (unit identity, Ironclad): vindicator, biped, broad and short; a riveted box helm with cheek plates and an ember crest over a copper beard braided to the belt, layered slab pauldrons, a breastplate over a soot-iron scale coat, a chequy team tabard, a brass-buckled belt, knee cops and sabatons; the shield on the left arm. Tier II brass rivets, comb, brow, nasal, rims, boss and a fourth pauldron lame; tier III brass rims on all plate, brass-edged scales, bone helm horns, boss spikes and ember-seamed tassets. No back flag.
